EUCHRE RULES

1. THE OBJECTIVE
First team to 10 points wins. You win points by taking at least 3 out of 5 tricks in a round.

2. THE DECK
Uses 24 cards: 9, 10, J, Q, K, and A of all suits.

3. THE BOWERS (TRUMP)
When a suit is Trump, the hierarchy is:
• Right Bower: Jack of Trump (Highest)
• Left Bower: Jack of same color (2nd Highest)
• Ace, King, Queen, 10, 9 of Trump

4. THE BIDDING
Players choose to 'Order Up' the face-up card or pass. If all pass, any suit can be named Trump.

5. SCORING
• Take 3 or 4 tricks: 1 point
• Take all 5 tricks: 2 points
• Go Alone take all 5: 4 points
• Defenders 'Euchre' the makers: 2 points
